description: This file defines a template class 'ParserType' for parsing text streams with various states, as well as classes for parsing text fragments and file paths within the 'WPEFramework::Core' namespace. It includes method declarations for parsing, validation, and extracting structured data from text, and references several other local header files.

classes.name: ParserType
classes.description: A template class for parsing streams of text with various parsing states, supporting operations like collecting words, lines, pass-through, and deserialization of data streams.

classes.name: TextParser
classes.description: A class for parsing text fragments, providing methods to read text, skip characters, validate content, and extract numbers, enumerations, key-value pairs, and ranges.

classes.name: PathParser
classes.description: A class for parsing file path strings into drive, path, filename, basename, and extension components.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the parser state to initial conditions.

methods.name: Position
methods.description: Returns the current position in the stream.

methods.name: CollectWord
methods.description: Sets the parser state to collect a word.

methods.name: CollectWord
methods.description: Sets the parser state to collect a word with a specified split character.

methods.name: CollectWord
methods.description: Sets the parser state to collect a word with a specified case state.

methods.name: CollectWord
methods.description: Sets the parser state to collect a word with a split character and case state.

methods.name: CollectLine
methods.description: Sets the parser state to collect a line.

methods.name: CollectLine
methods.description: Sets the parser state to collect a line with a specified case state.

methods.name: FlushLine
methods.description: Sets the parser to flush the current line.

methods.name: PassThrough
methods.description: Sets the parser to pass through a specified number of bytes.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a stream of bytes into parser state and buffers.

methods.name: ReadText
methods.description: Reads text from a fragment, extracting tokens based on delimiters.

methods.name: Skip
methods.description: Skips a specified number of characters or positions.

methods.name: Find
methods.description: Finds specified characters in the text fragment.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates the current text fragment against a comparison, case-sensitive or insensitive.

methods.name: ReadNumber
methods.description: Reads a number of a specified type from the text fragment.

methods.name: ReadEnumerate
methods.description: Reads an enumeration value from the text fragment.

methods.name: ReadKeyValuePair
methods.description: Reads a key-value pair from the text fragment based on a delimiter.

methods.name: ReadRange
methods.description: Reads a range of numbers from the text fragment.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a text fragment into components like drive, path, filename, etc.
